title: Car Breaks Down
description: The car will not start on a morning when everyone needs to be somewhere.
memory: A sudden car breakdown forced you to spend savings and juggle everyone's schedule.

title: Furnace Goes Out
description: The furnace quits during a cold snap and the repair tech says replacement may be the safest option.
memory: You dealt with a failing furnace before the house became unsafe.

title: Fence Blows Down
description: A windstorm knocks down a section of fence and the yard suddenly needs a fix.
memory: A windstorm knocked down the fence and added an urgent repair to the month.

title: Surprise Medical Bill
description: An old appointment finally processes through insurance and leaves an awkward balance due.
memory: A delayed medical bill arrived and dented the budget.

title: Boss Quits Suddenly
description: Your boss resigns with almost no notice, leaving the team to absorb the mess for a while.
memory: Your boss quit suddenly, and the extra work took over more evenings than expected.

title: Family Favor Emergency
description: A relative needs last-minute help, and saying yes means rearranging an already packed month.
memory: You made room for a family favor when someone needed last-minute help.
